intent: Teach packing direction, wet-first ordering, literal booklet/brochure evidence, reservation nights, locked bicycle storage, downstairs shared kitchen and room-key reception instruction.
picturePurpose: Five changing coded diagrams, one ordering task and two exact evidence activities; exact objects, quantities and relations stay deterministic.
